'''Stefano'''  (Japanese: '''シゲキ''' ''Shigeki'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG062|Disguise Da Limit]]''. He is a [[Pokémon Coordinator]] who entered the [[Verdanturf Town]] [[Pokémon Contest]] with his {{p|Wartortle}} in hopes of winning the prestigious Verdanturf [[Ribbon]].

Although his performance in the [[Appeal|first round]] was not shown, it was deemed impressive enough by the [[Contest Judge|panel of judges]] and put him in the [[Contest Battle|Battle Stage]] of the Verdanturf Contest together with {{an|May}}, [[Timmy Grimm|Timmy]], and [[Jessie|Jesslana]]. There, he and his {{p|Wartortle}} were matched up against May and her {{TP|May|Skitty}}. However, Wartortle ended up being defeated with relative ease. As a result, Stefano was eliminated from the competition.
